item.title: FDA User Fee Deal
item.description:
• Summary: The next FDA user fee agreement, which funds the agency's drug review programs (including PDUFA, GDUFA, and BsUFA), is currently under review at the White House. The deal will set review timelines and fee structures for the next five years, impacting industry submissions and agency operations.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: FDA Chaos Impact on Pharma
item.description:
• Summary: The article examines the impact of organizational chaos at the FDA on drug approval timelines and the broader pharmaceutical industry, including potential delays and regulatory uncertainty.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive

item.title: NIH Grant Guidance
item.description:
• Summary: This article discusses a proposal by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) to implement uniform guidance for grant management, potentially influenced by political control. The changes could impact how research funding is allocated and administered across various therapeutic areas.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News
